candidates.name: openvdb_sdf_driver
candidates.license: Apache-2.0 with retained permissive bundled-dependency notices
candidates.reason: Approved OSS with source-locked provenance, an identity-checked OpenVDB nanobind Python module and repository-owned bounded tools overlay, deterministic bounded operations, per-part execution, and independent drift/correspondence gates.
candidates.distribution_boundary: The source-locked OpenVDB 13 wheel and its audited shared libraries are installed in CAD Agent images with OpenVDB's Apache-2.0 license and bundled permissive notices. Content code calls the backend-neutral sdf_tools contract; the admitted openvdb_runtime driver executes in-process. Geometry Repair makes that call inside its existing generic isolated worker, without an OpenVDB helper or daemon.

candidates.name: geogram_local_repair

candidates.distribution_boundary: Pinned native executable and Geogram shared libraries with recursive source and notice inventory.
